info.name: SwiftRef API
info.description:
One of Swift's latest delivery channels for SwiftRef reference data are Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).  
APIs offer financial institutions, corporates and third party service providers an automated data look-up service  
for real-time identification and validation of critical payments reference data within the SwiftRef utility.

---

Contact Support:  
Name: Standards & Developer Hub  
Email: [developer-support@swift.com](https://mailto:developer-support@swift.com)

item.name: Check validity of a list of IBANs and get their BICs.

request.description: You can check whether several IBANs are valid and get their IBAN BICs.

item.name: Check validity of an IBAN and get its enhanced details.

request.description: You can check whether an IBAN is valid, get its details and IBAN BIC details.

item.name: Check validity of an IBAN, with SEPA-only option.

request.description: You can check whether an IBAN is valid, by restricting validation to SEPA countries.

item.name: Get the BIC for an IBAN.

request.description: For a given IBAN, you can retrieve the BIC of the institution that services the IBAN. This API is compliant with the requirement for BIC from IBAN derivation defined in the Regulation (EU) No 260/2012.
For a given IBAN, you can obtain the components of the IBAN.
Build a valid IBAN from BBAN elements (e.g. bank code, branch code, account number). Required BBAN elements depend on the country.

item.name: Get the BIC for an IBAN national ID.

query.description: The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of the country that issued the IBAN National ID

variable.description: IBAN national ID for which the corresponding BIC is requested

request.description: For a given IBAN national ID, you can retrieve the BIC of the institution that services the IBAN.

item.name: Get the IBAN from a BBAN.

request.description: For a given Basic Bank Account Number (BBAN), you can retrieve the corresponding IBAN; you must also provide a country code.

item.name: Get BBAN elements of an IBAN country.

query.description: The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of an IBAN country

request.description: Get all BBAN element combinations that can be used as input of IBAN constructor for a specific country. Each BBAN element is described by name, length, mandatory/optional flag, position within BBAN.

query.description: A date in YYYY-MM-DD format

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) to validate

request.description: You can check whether a BIC is correct and valid, that is whether it is published in the BIC Directory; optionally, you can check whether a BIC was valid at a particular date in the past.

item.name: Get the LEI for a BIC.

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) for which the corresponding LEI is requested

request.description: For a given BIC (Business Identifier Code), you can retrieve the LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) of that BIC.

item.name: Get National IDs for a BIC.

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) for which the corresponding National IDs are requested

request.description: For a given BIC, you can retrieve the National IDs of that BIC.

item.name: Validate SEPA reachability of a BIC.

query.description: SEPA service code

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) for which SEPA reachability is requested

request.description: For a given BIC and SEPA payment scheme, you can validate that it can be reached for SEPA payments and return the SEPA channel CSM (Clearing and Settlement System) through which the bank owning the BIC can be reached; the response also returns the adherence BIC that signed the adherence agreement with the EPC and the intermediary institution's BIC (if applicable and available).

query.description: A 3-character currency code for which SSI data needs to be retrieved
Code that indicates the asset category for which SSI data needs to be retrieved

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) for which the corresponding SSIs are requested

request.description: For a given BIC, you can retrieve the Standing Settlement Instructions (SSIs) for that BIC, for a given currency, and (optionally) an asset category.

variable.description: BIC resource identifier

request.description: For a given BIC, retrieve the related connected BIC (or Swift BIC), which is a BIC connected to the Swift network, therefore usable in the header of a Swift message. If available, it is a BIC of the same institution, otherwise it's the correspondent through which the input BIC connects.

variable.description: BIC (8-characters or 11-characters) for which details are requested

request.description: For a given BIC, you can retrieve the details of that BIC, that is the bank name or business name, and the address and the Swift service details.

item.name: Get the BIC for an LEI.

variable.description: LEI (20-characters) for which the corresponding BIC is requested

request.description: For a given LEI, you can retrieve the BIC of that LEI.

variable.description: LEI to validate

request.description: You can check whether a LEI is formally correct and exists.

variable.description: LEI for which details are requested

request.description: For a given LEI, you can retrieve the details of that LEI.

item.name: Check the Validity of a National ID.

query.description: The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of the country that issued the National ID (mandatory, when scheme parameter is not provided)

The scheme (a synonym for the National ID type) under which the National ID is defined (mandatory, when country_code parameter is not provided); it maps all possible National ID types (id_type, national_id_type, iso_clc_type)

variable.description: National ID (a synonym for clearing code, routing code, sort code, bank and branch ID) to validate

request.description: With this API call, you can check whether a National ID format is correct and the value exists in Swift's list of National IDs; you need to provide the National ID, and either a country code, or an indication to which scheme this National ID belongs.

item.name: Get BICs of a National ID.

query.description: The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of the country that issued the National ID (mandatory, when scheme parameter is not provided)
The scheme (a synonym for the National ID type) under which the National ID is defined (mandatory, when country_code parameter is not provided)

variable.description: National ID (a synonym for clearing code, routing code, sort code, bank and branch ID) for which the corresponding BICs are requested

request.description: For a given National ID, you can retrieve the BIC or the BICs of that National ID; you need to provide the National ID, and either a country code, or an indication to which scheme this National ID belongs.

item.name: Get details of a National ID.

query.description: The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of the country that issued the National ID (mandatory, when scheme parameter is not provided)
The scheme (a synonym for the National ID type) under which the National ID is defined (mandatory, when country_code parameter is not provided)
Whether fields must be returned in local language

variable.description: National ID (a synonym for clearing code, routing code, sort code, bank and branch ID) for which details are requested

request.description: For a given National ID, you can retrieve the details of that National ID, that is the bank name or business name, and the address. You must provide either a country code, or an indication to which scheme the National ID belongs.

item.name: Check validity of a country code.

variable.description: Country code (2-letters, 3-letters or 3-digits) to validate

request.description: You can check whether a country code is correct and valid.

item.name: Get details of a country code.

variable.description: Country code (2-letters, 3-letters or 3-digits) for which details are requested

request.description: For a given country code, you can retrieve the details of that country code, that is the name, other codes and official currencies.

item.name: Check validity of a currency code.

variable.description: Currency code (3-letters or 3-digits) to validate

request.description: You can check whether a currency code is correct and valid.

item.name: Check validity of a currency amount.

query.description: Currency amount to validate

variable.description: Currency code (3-letters or 3-digits) of the amount to validate

request.description: You can check whether an amount is valid for a specific currency.

item.name: Get details of a currency code.

variable.description: Currency code (3-letters or 3-digits) for which details are requested

request.description: For a given currency code, you can retrieve the details of that currency code, that is the name, other codes, the fractional digits and the list of countries where the currency is used.

item.name: Check validity of account number formats, including IBANs.

request.description: Check validity of account number formats, including IBANs, issued in almost any country in the world.

item.name: Check validity of account number formats, including IBANs and get their institution details.

request.description: Check validity of account number formats, including IBANs, issued in almost any country in the world, and get their institution details.

request.description: Get Payment Market Infrastructure details for the given service ID.

Part of the name of the Payment Market Infrastructure
Currency cleared or settled on the Payment Market Infrastructure service
The 2-character ISO 3166-1 country code of a Payment Market Infrastructure

request.description: Get a list of Payment Market Infrastructures matching the input parameters.

item.name: Search for identifiers associated to institutions.

query.description: Text to search for within identifier attribute values, e.g. identifier code, institution name and address (to match, the parameter text must only be contained in identifier attribute values, no need for an exact match)
Part of the identifier type

Status of the institution identifiers to search for

request.description: Get a list of institution identifiers matching all input parameters (parameter values searched by enforcing logical AND).
